summary: A Harley Street address, WhatsApp on the page and long opening hours are strengths, but contradictory prices and advice appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The Botox page appears to say costs run from £300 to £2,040 beside From £220 and £225 per area, and a £20 consultation redeemable against treatment beside a complimentary consultation.
findings.cost: Conflicting prices make a patient doubt the real cost.
findings.fix: One clear price list and one consultation offer.

findings.problem: Aftercare appears to say do not lie down for three hours in one place and stay upright for at least four hours in another, and results appear as 3 to 7 days, 3 to 5 days and 10 to 14 days.
findings.cost: Contradictory medical advice weakens trust in a clinical brand.
findings.fix: One reviewed aftercare and results timeline.

findings.problem: The Before & After links appear to go to #, the images appear blank, the Patient Testimonials section appears to be only an image, and a Secret Link sits in the footer.
findings.cost: No visible results or readable reviews for a cosmetic clinic.
findings.fix: Captioned before and after photos and readable reviews.

findings.problem: Typos appear such as 'time off work i have to take', 'Medical Botox Treatments :Botox' and 'botox work begins', and two unlabeled phone numbers show.
findings.cost: Small errors and unclear numbers lose bookings.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and labeled contact numbers.

redesign: One price list and consultation offer.
Captioned results, readable reviews, clean copy.
